name: encore
description: Build backends in TypeScript and Go with automatic infrastructure. Includes MCP integration for inspecting services, querying databases, analyzing traces, and calling endpoints. Plus rules, skills, and commands for the full Encore workflow.

skills.name: add-infrastructure
skills.description: Add infrastructure primitives (databases, Pub/Sub, cron jobs, caching, object storage, secrets) to an Encore service. Use when the user wants to add a database, queue, cache, storage bucket, cron job, or secret.

skills.name: encore-api
skills.description: Create type-safe API endpoints with Encore.ts.

skills.name: encore-auth
skills.description: Implement authentication with auth handlers and gateways in Encore.ts.

skills.name: encore-code-review
skills.description: Review Encore.ts code for best practices and anti-patterns.

skills.name: create-service
skills.description: Create a new Encore service with API endpoints, database, and infrastructure. Use when the user wants to add a new service, create endpoints, or scaffold a new part of their backend.

skills.name: encore-database
skills.description: Database queries, migrations, and ORM integration with Encore.ts.

skills.name: debug-traces
skills.description: Debug Encore applications using distributed traces. Use when the user reports an error, wants to understand request flow, or needs to diagnose performance issues. Requires the MCP server to be running.

skills.name: encore-frontend
skills.description: Connect React/Next.js apps to Encore.ts backends.

skills.name: encore-getting-started
